# 

## Purpose

Renders every analysis document in the required order. Each document runs independently and writes its own HTML to \`results/\`.

```{r}
#| label: 00_setup
#| message: false
library(here)
library(quarto)
```

```{r}
#| label: render-all
#| message: false
#| echo: false
#| eval: false # change to true later
steps <- c(
  "01_load.qmd",
  "02_clean.qmd",
  "03_augment.qmd",
  "04_describe.qmd",
  "05_analysis_1.qmd",
  "06_analysis_2.qmd"
)

for (step in steps) {
  message("Rendering ", step)
  quarto_render(here("R", step))
}
```
